points.why: Says a historical fit isn't validation and only shows tuned parameters reproduce the past, and that recalibrating would just add a fourth match.
Explains that the retry loop was absent from the calm past on-sales and recommends adding it and injecting a slowdown, but never proposes comparing runs with the loop on and off.
Recommends a link-by-link check by a non-builder app engineer and flagging any links that exist only to improve the fit.
Recommends pre-stating what would prove the model wrong and stress-testing retry multipliers and tipping points against the go/no-go decision.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly warns that recalibrating on this on-sale proves little and does not validate the model.
